# PURE SKI 滑雪純愛組

北海道中文滑雪學校（PURE SKI 株式会社），日本北海道合法註冊、持有正式工作簽證的 ISIA 國際認證教練團隊。提供 Ski 雙板與 Snowboard 單板全階段教學，中文、英文、日文授課，4 歲到 70 歲皆可安排課程。服務雪場：手稻、留壽都、星野 TOMAMU、札幌國際。

## 核心頁面

- 首頁: https://www.pureski-school.com/
- 雪場與課程總覽: https://www.pureski-school.com/ski-resort
- 教練團隊: https://www.pureski-school.com/team
- 新手 Q&A: https://www.pureski-school.com/faq
- 關於我們: https://www.pureski-school.com/about
- 裝備租借與加購: https://www.pureski-school.com/rental
- 滑雪專欄: https://www.pureski-school.com/blog

## 雪場課程頁

- 手稻: https://www.pureski-school.com/teine
- 札幌國際: https://www.pureski-school.com/sapporo-kokusai
- 星野 TOMAMU: https://www.pureski-school.com/tomamu
- 留壽都: https://www.pureski-school.com/rusutsu
